**8 of the 30 are incorrect, so 22 are correct.** All of this comes from Table 5 on **page 7**, which lists "the 30 most confident answers generated by GPT-2 on the development set of Natural Questions sorted by their probability according to GPT-2."

The PDF's text layer garbles the table's check and cross symbols: ✓ comes out as "3" and ✗ as "7". I read every "7" in the Correct column as ✗.

The 8 wrong answers (page 7, Table 5):

| Question | GPT-2's answer | Probability |
|---|---|---|
| What is the most common blood type in sweden? | A | 70.6% |
| Largest state in the us by land mass? | California | 59.2% |
| Green algae is an example of which type of reproduction? | parthenogenesis | 56.5% |
| What us state forms the western boundary of montana? | Montana | 52.3% |
| Who plays ser davos in game of thrones? | Peter Dinklage | 52.1% |
| Who appoints the chair of the federal reserve system? | Janet Yellen | 51.5% |
| Who won the most mvp awards in the nba? | Michael Jordan | 50.2% |
| Who played john connor in the original terminator? | Arnold Schwarzenegger | 45.2% |

The first error is the 7th most confident answer (blood type, 70.6%). The 30th answer, the last row of the table (John Connor, 45.2%), is also wrong.

Related facts:
- The caption says none of these questions appear in WebText (page 7).
- GPT-2 gets 4.1% of all Natural Questions right by exact match. On the 1% of questions it is most confident about, its accuracy is 63.1% (page 7, Section 3.8).
